problem: A broken agent session had no portable way to preserve all conversations, the active transcript, browser context, tool history, runtime identity, token state, and detailed diagnostics.
solution: Added a visible Recovery control and Command-Shift-E menu command that create a sanitized ZIP with all saved conversations, current BrowserOS context, transcripts, runtime metadata, detailed TriOS logs, a handoff guide, and a SHA-256 manifest. Keychain values are never read, secret patterns are redacted recursively, and archives are created atomically without shell interpolation.
lesson: A recovery export is trustworthy only when snapshot completeness, recursive redaction, archive path safety, manifest checksums, actual ZIP integrity, and a human-readable handoff are verified together. Redaction must also be idempotent so already sanitized archives and escaped JSON cannot accumulate corrupt markers.
